compliancePrinciples: Send polite, neutral review invitations after a service is confirmed complete—never gate reviews or divert unhappy clients away from public platforms.
Never offer cash, gift cards, or discounts in exchange for leaving a review.
Never fabricate testimonials, star ratings, or city attributions when a reviewer’s exact location is unknown.
Never inject self-serving AggregateRating schema on LocalBusiness pages where prohibited by Google Review Snippet guidelines.
Protect customer privacy in public replies—never disclose home addresses, lock codes, or private billing details.

postServiceWorkflowSteps.title: Confirm Service Completion & Quality Check
postServiceWorkflowSteps.detail: Verify the cleaning team has completed the 37-point, 47-point, or 56-point checklist and the visit is marked complete in dispatch records.

postServiceWorkflowSteps.title: Send Neutral Same-Day Follow-Up & 48-Hour Guarantee Reminder
postServiceWorkflowSteps.detail: Thank the homeowner for welcoming Mojo Cleaning into their home, remind them of the 48-Hour Happiness Guarantee if anything needs a touch-up, and provide a direct, neutral link to share honest feedback.

postServiceWorkflowSteps.title: Log Invitation & Monitor Response
postServiceWorkflowSteps.detail: Record that the review invitation was sent (max 1 polite reminder if no response) and respond personally to every published review.

postServiceWorkflowSteps.title: Feed Operational Insights Back to Cleaning Checklists
postServiceWorkflowSteps.detail: Review customer comments monthly to identify praised team habits or recurring friction points.

keyRules: Thank the customer by first name
Reference the general service value (e.g., recurring care or deep clean reset) without exposing private address details
responsePlaybook.templateText: Thank you so much, [Customer First Name]! Our team loved caring for your home, and we are thrilled that the kitchen and bathroom detailing made your week easier. Thank you for trusting Mojo Cleaning—we look forward to seeing you on your next scheduled visit!

responsePlaybook.scenario: Complaint About a Missed Area (48-Hour Guarantee Activation)
keyRules: Respond promptly and empathetically without defensiveness
Immediately offer the 48-Hour Happiness Guarantee free spot re-clean
Move specific scheduling logistics to direct phone/email
responsePlaybook.templateText: Thank you for sharing this feedback, [Customer First Name]. We hold our team to a strict room-by-room checklist, and we are sorry we missed that detail during your visit. Every Mojo Cleaning appointment is backed by our 48-Hour Happiness Guarantee—we have reached out directly (or please call/text us at (256) 418-8199) so we can send our team back out to re-clean that area for you free of charge.

keyRules: Acknowledge the value of the homeowner’s time
Explain how dispatch notifications are being improved
responsePlaybook.templateText: Hi [Customer First Name], thank you for your honest feedback. We know how important reliable arrival windows are for your schedule, and we apologize for the delay on your appointment day. We have reviewed our dispatch routing for your area and would love to speak with you directly at (256) 418-8199 to make this right.

keyRules: Reference how 37-point Standard, 47-point Deep, and 56-point Move-Out scopes differ without arguing publicly
responsePlaybook.templateText: Thank you for reaching out, [Customer First Name]. We always want our service scope and quote estimates to be 100% clear before we begin. Please give our management team a call at (256) 418-8199 so we can review your visit notes together and ensure you are taken care of.
